prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1025; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a head-on impact, and our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you, your insured, or any representative acting on their behalf.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including all applicable bodily injury and property damage liability limits, and confirm whether any additional coverage or excess policies may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes, without limitation, photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair and total loss records, and any communications with your insured or third parties. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
